sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Santa Claus, also known as Ded Moroz, is an Event Boss in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- Santa Claus has different health values than PMCs and Scavs.
- Santa Claus is cold blooded and can hardly be spotted with thermal vision devices.
| Stats |
| Head: 80; Thorax: 280; Stomach: 180; Arms: 120 each; Legs: 130 each; Total: 1,040 |

sections.heading: Location
sections.text: Santa Claus wanders on all locations except The Lab and The Labyrinth.

sections.heading: Behavior
sections.text: If he encounters a player, he will not be hostile unless fired upon. When approached, he will drop a random item, gesturing and looking at it until it is taken.
